Leading Companies We Work With

About the Company

Engineering Expertise for Leading Complex Projects

S.Y.E TECHNOLOGICAL SOLUTIONS LTD. specializes in the development and implementation of complex engineering systems integrating mechanics, hydraulics, pneumatics, control systems and HMIs. The company also provides solutions for planning and implementing production lines and for improving and optimizing manufacturing processes.

Every project is managed by a multidisciplinary team of engineering, quality assurance and project management professionals. Working together enables the team to coordinate all engineering and operational interfaces, meet professional requirements, and lead even complex, large-scale projects in an organized and efficient manner.

The company follows a structured engineering design methodology, from understanding the need, defining requirements and specifying the system, through design, manufacturing and integration, to testing, delivery and ongoing engineering support.

Multidisciplinary Teams

Integrated Expertise. Full Accountability.

Our teams combine knowledge and experience in engineering, quality assurance and project management. A dedicated professional team is assembled for each project according to its requirements, with the goal of leading it from the initial need to an operational, tested system ready for field use.

Services and Capabilities

Turning Challenges into Solutions

01

Engineering Consulting and Specification

Defining requirements and technology priorities, and evaluating alternatives at the initial stage of the project.

02

Development of Custom Machinery and Systems

Design and construction of unique machines and equipment that are not available off the shelf, from concept to an operational machine.

03

Production Line Design and Upgrades

Implementation, upgrades and enhancement of production lines and existing systems, including adapting manufacturing processes to product requirements.

04

Automation and Process Optimization

Integrated control systems (PLC/HMI) for process management, real-time data collection and improved output.

05

Test Fixtures and Systems

Design and manufacture of systems for leak and seal testing of components, tailored to product and manufacturing process requirements.

06

Upgrading and Enhancing Existing Systems

Mechanical and control upgrades for existing equipment, from industrial mixers to ovens and purpose-built systems.

07

Engineering Support, Integration and Guidance

Full or partial support throughout the project, according to client requirements, using a structured methodology (SRR / SDR / PDR / CDR / ATP).

08

Knowledge Transfer and Training in Israel and Worldwide

Professional knowledge transfer, team training and implementation of systems and work processes in Israel and worldwide, according to the needs of the client and the project.

09

Production Machine Maintenance and Operational Readiness

Maintenance services for machinery and production lines, troubleshooting and operational readiness testing to maintain system reliability and operational continuity.

Selected Projects

From Engineering Need to Operational System

A selection of company projects demonstrating the breadth of our engineering capabilities across different industries.

Industrial · Testing
The Challenge

Testing component leak-tightness within short cycle times and with high precision, while meeting varying product requirements.

Leak Test Workstation

A system for component leak-tightness testing using pressure-decay measurements, positive and negative, with cycle times of 30 to 60 seconds, PLC control and pass/fail indication.

  • Pneumatics
  • PLC Control
  • Precision Pressure Measurement
  • Barcode / Documentation
Medical
The Challenge

Parallel leak testing of multiple catheter bags, with quick model changeover between runs.

Catheter Bag Leak Test System

Multi-channel test station with a removable front panel for changing bag models, linear rails for each drawer and a spring-loaded locking pin for each test station.

  • Modular Design
  • Multiple Test Channels
  • Medical Industry
Industrial
The Challenge

Injection of viscous materials at high operating pressure, with precise real-time position and speed control.

35-Ton Hydraulic Injection Press

Vertical piston force of 1.5 to 18 tons and horizontal piston force of 2 to 35 tons (±5% tolerance), integrated position and speed control, PLC and HMI control, and process data collection.

  • Hydraulics
  • Real Time Control
  • PLC · HMI
Industrial
The Challenge

Developing components and molds for unique manufacturing processes for which no off-the-shelf solution exists.

Component and Mold Development and Design

Design and specification of component-level technological processes, including powder pressing, 3D printing, electroforming and viscous material injection.

  • Mechanical Design
  • Production Molds
  • Process Development
Controls · Automation
The Challenge

Consolidating a large number of valves and inputs/outputs in a single control cabinet with organized, serviceable wiring.

Control Cabinet Design and Build

Design and construction of pneumatic and hydraulic test equipment, including complete electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic schematics.

  • Electrical Panels
  • Pneumatics
  • Complete Engineering Documentation
Industrial · Hydraulics
The Challenge

Controlled operation of multiple cylinders using water in a compact, serviceable system.

Hydraulic System for Cylinder Actuation

A purpose-built system designed and built to operate multiple cylinders using water. The project included system design, component selection, drawing preparation, assembly and full integration.

  • Hydraulic Systems
  • Mechanical Design
  • Integration
  • Engineering Drawings
Industrial · Hydraulics
The Challenge

Testing components under hydraulic pressure while maintaining accurate and reliable measurements with an accuracy of 0.01 bar.

Hydraulic Pressure Component Test Equipment

Design and development of a purpose-built test system including a hydraulic circuit, control panel, and measurement and control instruments. The system performs precise, controlled pressure testing according to the test requirements.

  • Hydraulics
  • Pressure Control
  • High Precision
  • Test Equipment
Our Process

Five Stages, from Need to Delivery

Every project follows a structured engineering design methodology to ensure that the final solution meets the predefined technical, quality and safety requirements.

01

Understanding the Need

Understanding the engineering requirement, system constraints and technology priorities.

02

Concept Development

Defining the system architecture and its internal and external interfaces.

03

Engineering Design

Detailed design of the subsystems, review and approval before release to manufacturing.

04

Manufacturing and Integration

Manufacturing, assembly and integration of the mechanical, hydraulic and control subsystems.

05

Testing, Delivery and Support

System testing against quality and safety requirements, delivery and ongoing engineering support.

From Specification to Engineering Implementation

  • 01

    Multidisciplinary Hands-On Experience

    Integrating mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and control capabilities under one roof, eliminating the need to coordinate separate suppliers.

  • 02

    Full or Partial Support, as Needed

    We can join at any stage, from initial consulting to a complete turnkey project including manufacturing and integration.

  • 03

    Structured Work Methodology

    Every project is documented according to defined milestones (SRR/SDR/PDR/CDR/ATP) to reduce uncertainty and maintain quality.

  • 04

    Precisely Tailored to the Need, Not an Off-the-Shelf Solution

    Every system is built around the specific requirements of the client and the process, including sensitive and controlled environments.
